summary: For merchants, the service offers opportunities to increase sales, boost average order values, and reduce cart abandonment, while giving customers the added benefit of combining rewards from different cards

contentHtml:
Telr has partnered with CreditPool to introduce Telr Multi-Card Payments. Image courtesy: Telr

For merchants, the service offers opportunities to increase sales, boost average order values, and reduce cart abandonment, while giving customers the added benefit of combining rewards from different cards

Press Release

Dubai, UAE – Telr, a regulated regional payments provider with acquiring and payment capabilities across key Middle Eastern markets, has partnered with CreditPool to introduce Telr Multi-Card Payments, a first-of-its-kind service in the region, now available exclusively on Telr payment pages.

This pioneering feature lets customers split a single purchase across multiple cards, helping them overcome individual card limits and turning potential payment declines into successful transactions. For merchants, the service offers opportunities to increase sales, boost average order values, and reduce cart abandonment, while giving customers the added benefit of combining rewards from different cards.

Khalil Alami, Founder and CEO of Telr, commented: “Telr continues to pioneer payment innovation, and we are extremely proud to have partnered with CreditPool to introduce such a sophisticated payment solution, marking another first in the MENA region. We are excited to launch this groundbreaking service. Telr is a fintech-forward acquirer, redefining payments through innovation and security, and a trusted growth partner for every merchant. We won’t accept anything less.” Alami added: “It is with great pleasure that we launch this first-of-its-kind payment service as a result of our partnership with CreditPool. We are solving the number one reason for payment declines: insufficient funds, and turning declines into approvals to unlock limitless purchasing power and transform ambition into boundless success through Telr Multi-Card Payments and our full suite of services, as we continue towards a sophisticated, fully digital economy.” 

Rafik Ibrahim, Co-Founder and CEO of CreditPool, commented:

“At CreditPool, we believe every shopper should have the freedom to complete the purchases that matter to them, without the constraints of single-card limits. Telr’s trusted payments expertise makes them the right partner to help deliver a seamless and secure multi-card payment experience. This launch brings a new level of flexibility to the payment experience, helping merchants capture more revenue while improving the customer journey.”

Telr goes beyond payments with a comprehensive suite of e-commerce solutions, including social commerce, invoicing, Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL), and financing. Backed by the UAE Central Bank’s Retail Payment Services License, the launch of Telr Multi-Card Payments reinforces Telr’s position as a fintech pioneer, delivering secure, seamless, and future-ready solutions that support business growth across MENA. 

About Telr

Established in 2014, Telr is an award-winning UAE-based payments provider serving businesses across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, and Jordan. Telr combines proprietary payment technology, regional acquiring capabilities, and access to local and international payment methods through a single integration, supporting payment processing in more than 120 currencies and 30languages.

Telr is licensed by the Central Bank of the UAE for Retail Payment Services. In Saudi Arabia, Telr is certified as a Payment Technical Service Provider and operates under the authorization and oversight of the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA). Its payment capabilities include major card schemes, digital wallets and local payment methods, alongside solutions such as social commerce, QR payments, digital invoicing, Buy Now Pay Later and merchant financing.

Telr is PCI DSS Level 1 certified and has also achieved NESA certification, reflecting its focus on security, resilience and trusted payment infrastructure.

Learn more: www.telr.com  

About CreditPool:

At CreditPool, we believe payments should adapt to people, not the other way around.

CreditPool is a payment technology platform that allows customers to split a single purchase across multiple bank cards at checkout. Instead of being limited by the balance, limit, or rewards structure of one card, users can combine their existing cards seamlessly in one transaction.

We operate as a Technology Service Provider (TSP), integrating with licensed payment infrastructure partners to deliver a smoother and more flexible checkout experience for merchants and consumers alike. We do not issue credit cards, hold customer funds, or perform regulated financial activities.

Our mission is simple: reduce payment friction and unlock smarter ways to pay online.

Built in the UAE, CreditPool is designed for the future of commerce, where payments become more intelligent, flexible, and personalized.
